project: Data Source Real-Data Integration (PI / SQL / REST)

features.title: Credential encryption + schema migration
features.description: AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt util in backend keyed by DATASOURCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Replace plaintext DataSource.password with secretCiphertext, add config Json for type-specific non-secret fields. Encrypt on create/update; never return the secret.

tasks.title: Service+DTO: encrypt on write, extend fields, keep secret out of responses

acceptance: DataSource secrets stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM), never plaintext
No API response or log contains the secret
config JSON holds SQL (port/driver) and REST (baseUrl/endpoint/method/authType/apiKey|token/headers) non-secret fields
verification: crypto round-trip + tamper-rejection test: ALL PASS (empty/colon/unicode)
features.notes: Migration was destructive (dropped password column with 4 existing rows) — applied with explicit user approval; those sources must have credentials re-entered. Runtime create->read secret-omission check deferred to F6 (needs live app).

features.title: Backend -> Python HTTP client

Errors mapped to AppException (504 timeout / 502 unreachable / 400 upstream 4xx); no body/headers/creds logged

features.title: Python: per-source PI dependency + data-source router

verification: build_pi_client(creds) reuses PIWebAPI + TagService/DataService (no duplicate PI integration)

features.title: Python: SQL connector
features.description: SQLAlchemy per driver: test_connection/list_tables/get_columns/query. Parameterized + safe identifier quoting, enforced LIMIT, read-only intent.
verification: Installed SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 + psycopg 3.3.4 + PyMySQL 1.2.0 (pinned in requirements.txt)
LIVE against local Postgres soft_sensor_db: test_connection ok, 17 tables, get_columns, query(3 rows)
Injection guards: unknown table/column/time_column rejected; identifiers validated via reflection, values bound, LIMIT capped at 50000
features.notes: postgres+mysql wired; mysql/mariadb (pymysql) not live-tested (no MySQL instance). mssql/sqlserver BLOCKED — needs system ODBC driver (pyodbc).

features.title: Python: REST connector
features.description: httpx test_connection/fetch with auth (basic/bearer/api-key/header), method allow-list, timeout, bounded retry, JSON extraction. SSRF guard on base URL.
